comments.author: alice
comments.body: New money-moving endpoint without `@idempotent`, which the first commit was missing. Even for us 🙂 (ADR-004).

comments.author: erin
comments.body: Should the conversion use `Decimal` for the intermediate result? At my previous company we always converted currency with Decimal to avoid precision loss.

comments.author: bob
comments.body: Good instinct in general, but we deliberately don't here. ADR-007: money is int minor units end to end, and the conversion in fx.py uses integer micro-rates with a single half-even rounding step, so nothing is lost. Decimal is what we moved away from in March (#112), because the int<->Decimal boundaries were where the rounding mismatches happened.

comments.author: erin
comments.body: Ah, that makes sense. Thanks for the context!

threads.rejection_reason: ADR-007: int minor units end to end; fx.py does integer maths with one rounding step.
